title: cutting room floor - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 12 NPCs from cutting room floor.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by cutting room floor (cutting room floor.esp).

Install this if cutting room floor.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
